# Sellbio Backend - Convenções NestJS & Padrões SOLID

Projeto backend NestJS com arquitetura hexagonal. Siga rigorosamente os padrões abaixo para manter coesão, rastreabilidade e SOLID.

**Stack**: NestJS 11 + TypeORM + PostgreSQL 15 + Docker Compose + Jest

---

## 1. Estrutura de Módulos

Cada feature em `src/modules/app/{feature}/`:

```
{feature}/
├── application/
│   ├── use-cases/
│   │   ├── {action}/
│   │   │   ├── {action}-{feature}.use-case.ts
│   │   │   ├── {action}-{feature}.use-case.spec.ts  ← TESTES OBRIGATÓRIOS
│   │   │   ├── types.ts
│   │   └── ...
│   ├── services/
│   │   ├── {service-name}/
│   │   │   ├── {service-name}.service.ts
│   │   │   ├── {service-name}.service.spec.ts
│   │   │   ├── types.ts
│   │   └── ...
│   ├── entities/
│   │   ├── {entity}/
│   │   │   ├── {entity}.ts                         ← Domain entity (getters/setters)
│   │   │   ├── {entity}.spec.ts                    ← Testes da entidade
│   │   │   ├── types.ts                            ← Interfaces/tipos
├── dtos/
│   ├── {action}.dto.ts
├── infra/
│   └── http/
│       ├── controllers/
│       │   ├── {action}-{feature}.controller.ts
│       └── database/
│           ├── {feature}.repository.ts (interface abstrata)
│           ├── typeorm/
│           │   ├── repositories/
│           │   │   └── {feature}-repository.typeorm.ts
│           │   └── mappers/
│           │       └── {feature}.mapper.ts
├── {feature}.module.ts
```

**Referência**: [src/modules/app/users/](src/modules/app/users/) (módulo Users com 7 use-cases completos)

## 2. Use Cases com Testes Unitários

### Convenções

- **Classe**: `{Action}{Feature}UseCase` (ex: `CreateUserUseCase`)
- **Arquivo**: `application/use-cases/{action}/{action}-{feature}.use-case.ts`
- **Testes**: `application/use-cases/{action}/{action}-{feature}.use-case.spec.ts` (obrigatório)
- **Tipagem**: `application/use-cases/{action}/types.ts` (obrigatório)
- **Método**: `async execute(data: {Action}{Feature}RequestProps): Promise<{Action}{Feature}ResponseProps>`

### Implementação de Use Case

```typescript
// application/use-cases/create/create-product.use-case.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { CreateProductRequestProps, CreateProductResponseProps } from './types.ts';
import { ProductsRepository } from '../../infra/http/database/products.repository';
import { Product } from '../../application/entities/product/product';
import { BadRequestException } from '@/core/exceptions/bad-request.exception';
import { CONTEXT_PRODUCT } from '@/core/constants/enum';

@Injectable()
export class CreateProductUseCase {
  constructor(
    private repository: ProductsRepository,
    private findByNameService: FindByNameProductService,
  ) {
    super(repository);
  }

  async execute(data: CreateProductRequestProps): Promise<CreateProductResponseProps> {
    // 1. Validações de negócio
    const productExists = await this.findByNameService.execute(data.name);
    if (productExists) {
      throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.CREATE, 'Product name already exists');
    }

    // 2. Criar entidade de domínio
    const product = new Product({
      name: data.name,
      description: data.description,
      price: data.price,
      stock: data.stock,
    });

    // 3. Persistir via repositório
    const productCreated = await this.repository.create(product);

    // 4. Retornar DTO
    return new CreateProductResponseDto(productCreated);
  }
}

// application/use-cases/create/types.ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { createProductRequestSchema, createProductResponseSchema } from '../../dtos/requests/create/create-product.dto';

export type CreateProductRequestProps = z.infer<typeof createProductRequestSchema>;

export type CreateProductResponseProps = z.infer<typeof createProductResponseSchema>;
```

### Testes de Use Case (Padrão AAA)

```typescript
// application/use-cases/create/create-product.use-case.spec.ts
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { CreateProductUseCase } from './create-product.use-case';
import { CreateProductRequestDto } from '../../../dtos/requests/create/create-product-request.dto';
import { InMemoryProductRepository } from '@test/repositories/in-memory-product-repository';
import { FindByNameProductService } from '../../services/find-by-name/find-by-name-product.service';
import { BadRequestException } from '@/core/exceptions/bad-request.exception';

describe('CreateProductUseCase', () => {
  let useCase: CreateProductUseCase;
  let mockRepository: InMemoryProductRepository;
  let mockFindByNameService: FindByNameProductService;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    mockRepository = new InMemoryProductRepository();
    mockFindByNameService = new FindByNameProductService(mockRepository);
    useCase = new CreateProductUseCase(mockRepository, mockFindByNameService);
  });

  describe('execute', () => {
    it('should create a product successfully', async () => {
      // Arrange
      const input: CreateProductRequestDto = {
        name: 'Gaming Laptop',
        description: 'High-performance laptop',
        price: 1500.00,
        stock: 10,
      };

      // Act
      const result = await useCase.execute(input);

      // Assert
      expect(result.uuid).toBeDefined();
      expect(result.name).toBe('Gaming Laptop');
      expect(result.price).toBe(1500.00);
      expect(result.stock).toBe(10);
    });

    it('should throw BadRequestException if product name already exists', async () => {
      // Arrange
      const input: CreateProductRequestDto = {
        name: 'Duplicate Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100.00,
        stock: 5,
      };

      // Act: Criar primeiro produto
      await useCase.execute(input);

      // Assert: Tentar criar novamente deve falhar
      await expect(useCase.execute(input)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('should throw error if price is invalid (negative or zero)', async () => {
      // Arrange
      const input: CreateProductRequestDto = {
        name: 'Invalid Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: -100,
        stock: 5,
      };

      // Act & Assert
      await expect(useCase.execute(input)).rejects.toThrow();
    });

    it('should throw error if stock is negative', async () => {
      // Arrange
      const input: CreateProductRequestDto = {
        name: 'Invalid Stock',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: -5,
      };

      // Act & Assert
      await expect(useCase.execute(input)).rejects.toThrow();
    });
  });
});
```

**Padrão AAA obrigatório**:
1. **Arrange**: Preparar dados, mocks e infraestrutura
2. **Act**: Executar o método testado
3. **Assert**: Validar resultado ou exceção esperada

**Use InMemoryRepository em testes** (não mockizar com jest.mock()):

```typescript
// test/repositories/in-memory-product-repository.ts
export class InMemoryProductRepository implements IProductRepository {
  private products: Product[] = [];

  async create(product: Product): Promise<Product> {
    const newProduct = { ...product };
    this.products.push(newProduct);
    return newProduct;
  }

  async findByName(name: string): Promise<Product | null> {
    return this.products.find(p => p.getName() === name) || null;
  }

  async findByUuid(uuid: string): Promise<Product | null> {
    return this.products.find(p => p.getUuid() === uuid) || null;
  }

  // ... demais métodos
}
```

## 3. Entities de Domínio (Estrutura Completa)

### Organização por Entity

```
entities/
├── {entity}/
│   ├── {entity}.ts              ← Domain entity (getters/setters/comportamentos)
│   ├── {entity}.spec.ts         ← Testes de comportamento
│   ├── types.ts        ← Interfaces/tipos específicos
```

### Types (`types.ts`)

```typescript
// entities/product/types.ts
export interface ProductProps {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: number;
  stock: number;
  isActive?: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date | null;
  deletedAt: Date | null;
}

export interface ProductReplaceProps {
  isActive?: boolean;
  createdAt?: Date;
  updatedAt?: Date | null;
  deletedAt?: Date | null;
}
```

### Entity (`{entity}.ts`)

```typescript
// entities/product/product.ts
import { ProductProps, ProductReplaceProps } from './product.types';
import { BadRequestException } from '@/core/exceptions/bad-request.exception';
import { CONTEXT_PRODUCT } from '@/core/constants/enum';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export class Product {
  private _uuid: string;
  private props: ProductProps;

  constructor(
    props: Replace<ProductProps, ProductReplaceProps>,
    uuid?: string
  ) {
    this._uuid = props.uuid || randomUUID();
    this.props = { 
      ...props,
      isActive: props.isActive !== undefined ? props.isActive : true,
      createdAt: props.createdAt instanceof Date ? props.createdAt : (props.createdAt ? new Date(props.createdAt) : new Date()),
      updatedAt: props.updatedAt instanceof Date ? props.updatedAt : (props.updatedAt ? new Date(props.updatedAt) : null),
      deletedAt: props.deletedAt instanceof Date ? props.deletedAt : (props.deletedAt ? new Date(props.deletedAt) : null),
    };
  }

  // ===== GETTERS =====
  getUuid(): string { return this.uuid; }
  getName(): string { return this.name; }
  getDescription(): string { return this.description; }
  getPrice(): number { return this.price; }
  getStock(): number { return this.stock; }
  getStatus(): ProductStatusType { return this.status; }
  getCreatedAt(): Date { return this.createdAt; }
  getUpdatedAt(): Date { return this.updatedAt; }
  isDeleted(): boolean { return !!this.deletedAt; }

  // ===== SETTERS COM VALIDAÇÃO =====
  changeName(newName: string): void {
    if (!newName || newName.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.UPDATE, 'Product name cannot be empty');
    }
    this.name = newName;
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  changePrice(newPrice: number): void {
    if (newPrice <= 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.UPDATE, 'Product price must be greater than 0');
    }
    this.price = newPrice;
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  adjustStock(quantity: number): void {
    const newStock = this.stock + quantity;
    if (newStock < 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.UPDATE, 'Product stock cannot be negative');
    }
    this.stock = newStock;
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  // ===== COMPORTAMENTOS ENCAPSULADOS =====
  activate(): void {
    if (this.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.UPDATE, 'Product is already active');
    }
    this.isActive = true;
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  deactivate(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.UPDATE, 'Product is already inactive');
    }
    this.isActive = false;
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  delete(): void {
    this.deletedAt = new Date();
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  restore(): void {
    this.deletedAt = undefined;
    this.markAsUpdated();
  }

  // ===== MÉTODOS DE CONSULTA =====
  isAvailable(): boolean {
    return this.isActive && this.stock > 0 && !this.isDeleted();
  }

  canBePurchased(quantity: number): boolean {
    return this.isAvailable() && this.stock >= quantity;
  }

  // ===== HELPERS PRIVADOS =====
  private validate(): void {
    if (!this.name || this.name.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Product name is required');
    }
    if (this.price <= 0) {
      throw new Error('Product price must be greater than 0');
    }
    if (this.stock < 0) {
      throw new Error('Product stock cannot be negative');
    }
  }

  private markAsUpdated(): void {
    this.updatedAt = new Date();
  }
}
```

### Entity Tests (`{entity}.spec.ts`)

```typescript
// entities/product/product.spec.ts
import { Product } from './product';
import { BadRequestException } from '@/core/exceptions/bad-request.exception';

describe('Product Entity', () => {
  describe('constructor', () => {
    it('should create product with valid props', () => {
      // Arrange & Act
      const product = new Product({
        name: 'Laptop',
        description: 'Gaming laptop',
        price: 1500,
        stock: 10,
      });

      // Assert
      expect(product.getUuid()).toBeDefined();
      expect(product.getName()).toBe('Laptop');
      expect(product.getPrice()).toBe(1500);
      expect(product.getStock()).toBe(10);
      expect(product.getStatus()).toBe('active');
    });

    it('should throw error if name is empty', () => {
      expect(() => {
        new Product({
          name: '',
          description: 'Test',
          price: 100,
          stock: 5,
        });
      }).toThrow('Product name is required');
    });

    it('should throw error if price is invalid', () => {
      expect(() => {
        new Product({
          name: 'Product',
          description: 'Test',
          price: -50,
          stock: 5,
        });
      }).toThrow('Product price must be greater than 0');
    });
  });

  describe('changeName', () => {
    let product: Product;
    const originalUpdatedAt = new Date();

    beforeEach(() => {
      product = new Product({
        name: 'Original',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 5,
        updatedAt: originalUpdatedAt,
      });
    });

    it('should change name successfully', () => {
      // Act
      product.changeName('New Name');

      // Assert
      expect(product.getName()).toBe('New Name');
    });

    it('should throw error if new name is empty', () => {
      // Act & Assert
      expect(() => product.changeName('')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('should update updatedAt when name changes', () => {
      // Act
      product.changeName('New Name');

      // Assert
      expect(product.getUpdatedAt().getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(originalUpdatedAt.getTime());
    });
  });

  describe('adjustStock', () => {
    let product: Product;

    beforeEach(() => {
      product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 10,
      });
    });

    it('should increase stock', () => {
      // Act
      product.adjustStock(5);

      // Assert
      expect(product.getStock()).toBe(15);
    });

    it('should decrease stock', () => {
      // Act
      product.adjustStock(-3);

      // Assert
      expect(product.getStock()).toBe(7);
    });

    it('should throw error if stock becomes negative', () => {
      // Act & Assert
      expect(() => product.adjustStock(-20)).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
  });

  describe('activate/deactivate', () => {
    let product: Product;

    beforeEach(() => {
      product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 10,
      });
    });

    it('should deactivate product', () => {
      // Act
      product.deactivate();

      // Assert
      expect(product.getStatus()).toBe('inactive');
    });

    it('should activate product', () => {
      // Arrange
      product.deactivate();

      // Act
      product.activate();

      // Assert
      expect(product.getStatus()).toBe('active');
    });

    it('should throw error if already active', () => {
      // Act & Assert
      expect(() => product.activate()).toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
  });

  describe('isAvailable', () => {
    it('should be available if active, in stock, and not deleted', () => {
      // Arrange & Act
      const product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 10,
      });

      // Assert
      expect(product.isAvailable()).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should not be available if inactive', () => {
      // Arrange
      const product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 10,
      });

      // Act
      product.deactivate();

      // Assert
      expect(product.isAvailable()).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should not be available if out of stock', () => {
      // Arrange & Act
      const product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 0,
      });

      // Assert
      expect(product.isAvailable()).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should not be available if deleted', () => {
      // Arrange
      const product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 10,
      });

      // Act
      product.delete();

      // Assert
      expect(product.isAvailable()).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('canBePurchased', () => {
    let product: Product;

    beforeEach(() => {
      product = new Product({
        name: 'Product',
        description: 'Test',
        price: 100,
        stock: 10,
      });
    });

    it('should allow purchase if available and enough stock', () => {
      // Act & Assert
      expect(product.canBePurchased(5)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should not allow purchase if not enough stock', () => {
      // Act & Assert
      expect(product.canBePurchased(15)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should not allow purchase if inactive', () => {
      // Arrange
      product.deactivate();

      // Act & Assert
      expect(product.canBePurchased(5)).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});
```

## 4. DTOs com Zod

### Convenções

- **Request**: `{Action}{Feature}RequestDto`
- **Response**: `{Action}{Feature}ResponseDto`
- **Arquivo**: `dtos/{action}.dto.ts`
- **1 DTO por ação** (não reutilize genéricos)
- Use `createZodDto(schema)` do `nestjs-zod`

### Exemplo

```typescript
// dtos/requests/create/create-product-request.dto.ts
import { createZodDto } from 'nestjs-zod';
import { z } from 'zod';

const createProductRequestSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, 'Product name is required'),
  description: z.string().min(10, 'Description must have at least 10 characters'),
  price: z.number().positive('Price must be greater than 0'),
  stock: z.number().nonnegative('Stock cannot be negative'),
});

const createProductResponseSchema = z.object({
  uuid: z.string().uuid(),
  name: z.string(),
  description: z.string(),
  price: z.number(),
  stock: z.number(),
  status: z.enum(['active', 'inactive', 'archived']),
  createdAt: z.date(),
});

class CreateProductRequestDto extends createZodDto(createProductSchema) {}

class CreateProductResponseDto extends createZodDto(createProductResponseSchema) {}

export { CreateProductRequestDto, createProductRequestSchema, CreateProductResponseDto, createProductResponseSchema };
```

## 5. Repositórios (Abstração SOLID)

### Interface (`{feature}.repository.ts`)

```typescript
// infra/http/database/products.repository.ts
export interface IProductRepository {
  create(product: Product): Promise<Product>;
  findByUuid(uuid: string): Promise<Product | null>;
  findByName(name: string): Promise<Product | null>;
  list(skip: number, take: number): Promise<{ data: Product[]; total: number }>;
  save(product: Product): Promise<Product>;
  delete(uuid: string): Promise<void>;
}

export const ProductsRepository = Symbol('ProductsRepository');
```

### Implementação TypeORM

```typescript
// infra/http/database/typeorm/repositories/products-repository.typeorm.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { ProductEntity } from '@/infra/database/entities/product.entity';
import { Product } from '@/modules/app/products/application/entities/product/product';
import { IProductRepository } from '../products.repository';
import { ProductsMapper } from '../mappers/products.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class ProductsRepositoryTypeOrm implements IProductRepository {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(ProductEntity)
    private repository: Repository<ProductEntity>,
  ) {}

  async create(product: Product): Promise<Product> {
    const entity = ProductsMapper.toTypeOrm(product);
    const saved = await this.repository.save(entity);
    return ProductsMapper.toDomain(saved);
  }

  async findByUuid(uuid: string): Promise<Product | null> {
    const entity = await this.repository.findOne({ where: { uuid } });
    return entity ? ProductsMapper.toDomain(entity) : null;
  }

  async findByName(name: string): Promise<Product | null> {
    const entity = await this.repository.findOne({ where: { name } });
    return entity ? ProductsMapper.toDomain(entity) : null;
  }

  async list(skip: number, take: number): Promise<{ data: Product[]; total: number }> {
    const [entities, total] = await this.repository.findAndCount({
      skip,
      take,
      order: { createdAt: 'DESC' },
    });
    return {
      data: entities.map(e => ProductsMapper.toDomain(e)),
      total,
    };
  }

  async save(product: Product): Promise<Product> {
    const entity = ProductsMapper.toTypeOrm(product);
    const saved = await this.repository.save(entity);
    return ProductsMapper.toDomain(saved);
  }

  async delete(uuid: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.repository.softDelete({ uuid });
  }
}
```

## 6. Mappers (Domain ↔ ORM ↔ DTO)

```typescript
// infra/http/database/typeorm/mappers/products.mapper.ts
import { Product } from '@/modules/app/products/application/entities/product/product';
import { ProductEntity } from '@/infra/database/entities/product.entity';

export class ProductsMapper {
  static toTypeOrm(product: Product): ProductEntity {
    const entity = new ProductEntity();
    entity.uuid = product.getUuid();
    entity.name = product.getName();
    entity.description = product.getDescription();
    entity.price = product.getPrice();
    entity.stock = product.getStock();
    entity.status = product.getStatus();
    return entity;
  }

  static toDomain(entity: ProductEntity): Product {
    return new Product({
      uuid: entity.uuid,
      name: entity.name,
      description: entity.description,
      price: entity.price,
      stock: entity.stock,
      status: entity.status,
      createdAt: entity.createdAt,
      updatedAt: entity.updatedAt,
      deletedAt: entity.deletedAt,
    });
  }
}
```

## 7. Services

### Convenções

- **Classe**: `{Action}{Feature}Service`
- **Arquivo**: `application/services/{action}/{action}-{feature}.service.ts`
- **Uso**: Lógica reutilizável entre use-cases
- **Injete repositórios via Symbol**

### Exemplo

```typescript
// application/services/find-by-name/find-by-name-product.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { IProductRepository } from '@/modules/app/products/infra/http/database/products.repository';
import { Product } from '@/modules/app/products/application/entities/product/product';

@Injectable()
export class FindByNameProductService {
  constructor(
    private repository: IProductRepository,
  ) {}

  async execute(name: string): Promise<Product | null> {
    return this.repository.findByName(name);
  }
}
```

## 8. Controllers

### Convenções

- **Classe**: `{Action}{Feature}Controller`
- **Arquivo**: `infra/http/controllers/{action}-{feature}.controller.ts`
- **Método**: `handle()` que injeta use-case
- **Decorators**: Use `@AppController()` + `@AppPost/Get/Patch/etc()`

### Exemplo

```typescript
// infra/http/controllers/create-product.controller.ts
import { Body } from '@nestjs/common';
import { CreateProductUseCase } from '@/modules/app/products/application/use-cases/create/create-product.use-case';
import { CreateProductRequestDto, CreateProductResponseDto } from '@/modules/app/products/dtos/requests/create/create-product.dto';
import { AppController, AppPost } from '@/infra/decorators';

@AppController('Products')
export class CreateProductController {
  constructor(private readonly useCase: CreateProductUseCase) {}

  @AppPost({
    summary: 'Create a new product',
    body: CreateProductRequestDto,
    okResponse: CreateProductResponseDto,
  })
  async handle(@Body() body: CreateProductRequestDto) {
    return this.useCase.execute(body);
  }
}
```

## 9. TypeORM Entities

```typescript
// src/infra/database/entities/product.entity.ts
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
  DeleteDateColumn,
} from 'typeorm';

@Entity('products')
export class ProductEntity {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  uuid: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 255, unique: true })
  name: string;

  @Column({ type: 'text' })
  description: string;

  @Column({ type: 'decimal', precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  price: number;

  @Column({ type: 'integer', default: 0 })
  stock: number;

  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: ['active', 'inactive', 'archived'],
    default: 'active',
  })
  status: string;

  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;

  @DeleteDateColumn()
  deletedAt?: Date;
}
```

## 10. Decorators Customizados

[src/infra/decorators/](src/infra/decorators/):

- `@AppController(name)` — Aplica ApiTags + bad request docs
- `@AppPost({summary, body, okResponse})` — Post + Swagger docs
- `@AppGet()`, `@AppPatch()`, `@AppPut()`, `@AppDelete()` — Idem
- `@Public()` — Rota sem autenticação
- `@User()` — Extrai usuário do request

## 11. Tratamento de Erros

### Hierarquia de Exceções

- [ApplicationException](src/core/exceptions/application.exception.ts) (base)
- BadRequestException, NotFoundException

### Padrão de Uso

```typescript
throw new BadRequestException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.CREATE, 'Product name already exists');
throw new NotFoundException(CONTEXT_PRODUCT.READ, 'Product not found');

// Global filter formata automaticamente
```

## 14. Docker & Environment (Obrigatório)

### Docker Compose

O projeto utiliza **Docker Compose** para orquestrar serviços:

**Serviço PostgreSQL 15**:
- Container: `sellbio-postgres`
- Porta: `5432` (localhost:5432)
- Banco: `sellbio`
- Credenciais: `postgres:postgres`
- Volume: `postgres_data` (persistência)
- Restart: always

[docker-compose.yaml](docker-compose.yaml)

### Comandos Docker

```bash
# Iniciar stack
docker-compose up -d

# Ver logs
docker-compose logs -f db

# Parar
docker-compose down

# Limpar volumes
docker-compose down -v

# Acessar PostgreSQL
docker-compose exec db psql -U postgres -d sellbio
```

### Workflow Recomendado

1. **Iniciar Docker**: `docker-compose up -d`
2. **Verificar saúde**: `docker-compose exec db pg_isready`
3. **Rodar migrations**: `npm run migration:run`
4. **Iniciar app**: `npm run start:dev`
5. **Rodar testes**: `npm test`
6. **Parar**: `docker-compose down`

### Environment

[.env](.env) e [.env.test](.env.test):
```
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=5432
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_PASSWORD=postgres
DB_NAME=sellbio
```

---

## 15. Princípios SOLID

- **S**ingle Responsibility: 1 use-case = 1 ação, 1 service = 1 responsabilidade
- **O**pen/Closed: Extensível via interfaces abstratas, herança
- **L**iskov Substitution: Repositórios intercambiáveis (in-memory em testes)
- **I**nterface Segregation: DTOs e repositórios específicos por ação
- **D**ependency Injection: Injete abstrações, use Symbols

---

## 16. Injeção de Dependências no Módulo

```typescript
// {feature}.module.ts
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DatabaseModule } from '@/infra/database/database.module';
import { ProductsRepository, IProductRepository } from './infra/http/database/products.repository';
import { ProductsRepositoryTypeOrm } from './infra/http/database/typeorm/repositories/products-repository.typeorm';

import { CreateProductUseCase } from './application/use-cases/create/create-product.use-case';
import { ReadProductUseCase } from './application/use-cases/read/read-product.use-case';
// ... mais use-cases

import { FindByNameProductService } from './application/services/find-by-name/find-by-name-product.service';
// ... mais services

import { CreateProductController } from './infra/http/controllers/create-product.controller';
import { ReadProductController } from './infra/http/controllers/read-product.controller';
// ... mais controllers

@Module({
  imports: [DatabaseModule],
  providers: [
    // Services
    FindByNameProductService,

    // Use-cases
    CreateProductUseCase,
    ReadProductUseCase,

    // Repository injeção
    { provide: ProductsRepository, useClass: ProductsRepositoryTypeOrm },
  ],
  controllers: [CreateProductController, ReadProductController],
})
export class ProductsModule {}
```

Use `forwardRef(() => OtherModule)` se houver circular dependency.

## 19. Checklist: Criar Nova Feature

1. **Criar módulo**: `src/modules/app/{feature}/{feature}.module.ts`
2. **Estrutura base**: application/, dtos/, infra/http/
3. **Entity com tipos e testes**: `application/entities/{entity}/` com `.ts`, `.spec.ts`
4. **DTOs**: requests e responses em pastas separadas
5. **Repository interface + Mapper**: infra/http/database/
6. **TypeORM entity**: src/infra/database/entities/
7. **Use-cases + Testes**: `application/use-cases/{action}/` com `.spec.ts`, `types.ts` obrigatórios
8. **Services**: `application/services/` (se lógica compartilhada)
9. **Controllers**: `infra/http/controllers/` (1 por ação)
10. **Module registration**: Providers (services, use-cases, controllers, repository)
11. **Injeção no app.module** ou parent module
12. **Iniciar Docker**: `docker-compose up -d` **ANTES** de testes
